description: This Java source file defines the abstract class GenericMapValues, which provides a custom implementation of collection behaviors for the values of a Map, such as containment, equality, hash code, and removal operations.

classes.name: GenericMapValues
classes.description: An abstract class that provides collection-like behavior for the values of a Map, extending GenericMapCollection.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a specified object is among the map's values.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines if this collection is equal to another collection based on size and element contents.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Calculates the hash code of the collection based on its elements.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of an element from the collection if present.
